title: A defaultKimiEffort the session's model does not advertise refuses every first prompt
outcome: Review finding (Claude /review-code, Kimi parity, 2026-09-26). state_inner.rs create_session copies defaultKimiEffort onto every new Kimi session as kimiEffort without knowing which model the session will run; configure_kimi_thinking refuses the prompt when the model does not advertise that effort. A user who sets e.g. 'max' (advertised by one model) and starts sessions on a model without it gets a hard failure on each new session's first prompt until the effort is changed. Documented ('Checked when prompting') but a preference should not turn into a refusal. Options: show the mismatch in the creation dialog once the catalog is known, fall back to auto for a default-derived effort the model lacks (needs provenance: explicit vs default), or scope the default effort to the default model. Needs a product decision (Greg).
